title: Standby element
description: One element type that stands on the plan: a target, steel, mover, activator or prop. In an element extension the file is elements/<category>/<id>.json; an element drawn from files (art.kind "asset") has its drawing in assets/2d/<id>.svg and its model in assets/3d/<id>.glb.

id.description: The symbol id stored on placed elements, equal to the file name; never change it once stages use it (add an alias instead). A new extension's ids start with its own id.

category.description: The palette category, equal to the folder.

family.description: Counted families (target, steel, mover) are placed as targets, the rest as props.

disciplines.description: The disciplines whose palette shows the element.

labelFamily.description: Label prefix (T, S, A, B, Table), or null for unlabelled elements such as no-shoots.

boards.description: Boards counted per element (a flipper carries two).

art.description: How the plan and the 3D view draw the element: from its files (asset), or by one of Standby's builders, which move, carry other targets or take hits.

kind.description: asset: drawn from assets/2d/<id>.svg and assets/3d/<id>.glb. board, trap, popper, plate, swinger, updown, turner, flipper: Standby's builders, fed by this file and the boards. box and cylinder: elements made in the app, drawn at their real size in their own colour.

foot.description: asset: the foot point in the SVG's units, where it is not the bottom centre of its viewBox.

labelY.description: asset: how far above (negative) the foot point the label sits, mm at miniature scale 1; the middle of the drawing when not given.

board.description: The board (boards/<id>.json of any extension) a board target is drawn on.

half.description: Drawn at half size on its board (the CMA 50 % target).

white.description: Drawn in the no-shoot colours (how older no-shoots said so).

noShoot.description: A no-shoot, with its board's mark.

paint.description: The default painted hard cover: one of the board's covers and of the variants.

cover.description: The default hard-cover side: one of the board's covers and of the variants.

boardCover.description: flipper: the hard cover its boards show, by board id.

square.description: plate: a square plate instead of a round one.

scale.description: popper: how much smaller it is drawn on the plan (the mini popper).

target.description: trap: the target it carries where neither the placed trap nor the stage's discipline names one.

variants.description: Selectable art variants, stored on the element as `variant`.

views.description: Upright drawings for the ways the element can stand on the plan, such as a table across or along the range: it is drawn in the view its rotation is nearest to instead of turning one picture, and choosing a view in Properties sets the view's first rotation. Its rotation still turns it in 3D, for sight lines and for walking. The first view is drawn from assets/2d/<id>.svg, the others from assets/2d/<id>--<view>.svg.

rotations.description: The rotations it is drawn for, quarter turns in degrees; the first is the one choosing it sets.

depth.description: The depth front to back where it differs from the width (a box, a bullet trap, an ammo can); its width when not given.

mount.description: How high a target's face starts above the ground, mm: a popper 0, a plate 900; boards 800 when not given.

blocks.description: Hides what is behind it in sight lines: a block as wide as the element, `depth` front to back, up to `height` (its own height when not given).

footprint.description: A shooter walks round it in a run: a block as wide as the element and `depth` front to back. Without one it is stepped over or on.

surfaces.description: Where something can be put down on it, such as a gun on a table: each a height and a rectangle [x1, y1, x2, y2] or a circle [x, y, r] in its own frame, mm, x to the right as the shooter sees it and y toward him; the highest one a point lies on counts.

onSurface.description: Put down where a prop has a surface, it lies on its top in 3D, as a gun on a table does.

activation.description: How a shooter works an activator: steps on it (a pedal, a bear trap), pulls it, or presses it by hand (a push button). Its model's moving part is the node named `press`.

press.description: A push button: how high the middle of its face is above the ground and how far in front of its axis, mm.

carry.description: A prop the shooter carries or drags on the clock, such as a kettlebell or a rescue dummy: with how many hands, and whether it is carried off the ground or dragged along it. The round planner and the walkthrough use it.

mode.description: Carried off the ground, or dragged along it.

weight.description: The weight in kg a placed one starts with, for women and for men, such as a kettlebell's; Properties sets it per element. One value alone is the weight for everyone.

names.description: The name in each UI language.
